claims.hypothesis: ALMA CO(2-1) at 0.2-0.3 arcsec resolution can resolve Keplerian gas inside the BH sphere of influence in the radio galaxies NGC 315 and NGC 4261 and give dynamical BH masses
claims.experiment: Thin-disk forward-modeling of the CO cubes with HST/Spitzer-based MGE stellar mass models
claims.result: M_BH = 2.08e9 Msun (NGC 315) and 1.67e9 Msun (NGC 4261) with stat+sys uncertainties
claims.finding: ALMA can precisely measure BH masses in active galaxies; r_g is resolved by factors of ~5-10

evidence.quote: The observations demonstrate ALMA’s ability to precisely measure BH masses in active galaxies
tracing regular Keplerian rotation down to just tens of parsecs from the BHs

claims.hypothesis: The earlier ionized-gas M_BH for NGC 4261 was underestimated
claims.experiment: Compare the ALMA CO gas-dynamical M_BH with the earlier HST FOS ionized-gas value
claims.result: ALMA M_BH is ~3 times the earlier estimate
claims.finding: The prior ionized-gas measurement is revised upward by a factor of ~3

evidence.quote: we have revised the prior ionized gas-dynamical $M_\mathrm{BH}$ measurement (cite: ferrarese96) upward by a factor of $\sim$3.

claims.hypothesis: The new BH masses follow the M_BH-host galaxy scaling relations
claims.experiment: Compare with M_BH-sigma, M_BH-L_bul and M_BH-M_bul relations using MGE luminosities and literature velocity dispersions
claims.result: Both masses lie below the mean M_BH-sigma prediction but within the scatter; NGC 315 is below the M_BH-L_bul envelope
claims.finding: Masses are broadly consistent with the relations, with NGC 315 an outlier in M_BH-L_bul

evidence.quote: Our dynamical $M_\mathrm{BH}$ measurements for both galaxies are below the mean values predicted from the $\ensuremath{M_\mathrm{BH}}-\sigma_\star$ relation, but are within the intrinsic scatter of the relation.
Thus, our NGC 315 gas-dynamical $M_\mathrm{BH}$ is an outlier, lying below the lower envelope of BH masses populating the $\ensuremath{M_\mathrm{BH}}-L_{\mathrm{bul}}$ relation

claims.finding: Dust dominates the NGC 315 systematic budget, while NGC 4261 is limited by inclination and S/N

evidence.quote: As expected, the systematic uncertainties (sys) in the NGC 315 BH mass measurement are dominated by the uncertainty due to the dust correction.

evidence.quote: the 22% increase in BH mass when adopting the upper-bound inclination angle and the 12% decrease when changing from CO(2$-$1) to CO(3$-$2) kinematic modeling

why_this_data.value: Targets were selected from round dust disks in HST images, and the CO(2-1) resolution of ~0.3 arcsec was chosen to partly resolve kinematics inside the large expected r_g

evidence.quote: We therefore began an ALMA campaign to map CO(2$-$1) kinematics in nearby ETGs with targets selected based on dust morphology.

Based on their large anticipated $r_\mathrm{g}$, we imaged CO(2$-$1) in NGC 315 and NGC 4261 at $\sim$0.3$''$-resolution in order to at least partially resolve CO kinematics within the BH-dominated regions.

why_this_method.value: Fit the data cubes directly rather than moment maps to better assess goodness of fit

evidence.quote: The models were fit directly to the ALMA CO data cubes, thereby allowing better characterization of model goodness-of-fit than if the fits were made to only moment maps.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: NGC 4261 model D (exponential sigma_turb, i fixed) fits CO(2-1) better (chi2 = 1400.4) but was not adopted because i is not free; model C1 kept as fiducial

evidence.quote: Even though model D is a better fit to the CO(2$-$1) data with $\ensuremath{\chi^2}=1400.4$, because $i$ is not a free parameter we elected to retain model C1 as our fiducial gas-dynamical model for NGC 4261.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Authors did not inflate error bars or exclude poorly fit data to force chi2_nu = 1 for NGC 315

evidence.quote: We have chosen not to examine *ad hoc* procedures to address this issue

limitations_admitted.value: The NGC 315 systematic error budget is provisional because no model is a formally acceptable fit

evidence.quote: Our quoted systematic error budget for NGC 315 is provisional given that our models do not provide a formally acceptable fit to the data.

limitations_admitted.value: The NGC 4261 S/N does not permit a more general disk structure; degeneracies among M_BH, i and sigma_turb remain

evidence.quote: The S/N of the NGC 4261 CO(2$-$1) data does not permit exploration of a more general disk structure

limitations_admitted.value: M_BH scales linearly with the assumed distance, which is uncertain for NGC 315 and not folded into the error budget

evidence.quote: The derived $M_\mathrm{BH}$ scales linearly with the assumed distance, so any change to the distance will result in a commensurate shift in $M_\mathrm{BH}$.

referee_caveats_inferred: NGC 315 chi2_nu ~2 means the quoted statistical error (0.5%) is very small and the model-family systematics are not exhausted
The NGC 315 distance (Hubble-flow, 50-100 Mpc range in NED) is a leading uncertainty not included in the error bars
Thin-disk model forces fixed inclination for NGC 4261 models D and E, so the mass range depends on that choice
Stellar M/L is free and degenerate with the extinction-corrected MGE
Deconvolved flux map inside ~0.1" is non-unique and affects line profiles near the nucleus
